# WellarShop

> WellarShop is an online supermarket in Rwanda offering fresh groceries, beverages and pantry staples at retail prices, with approved wholesale pricing for bulk buyers.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Featured products and store overview.
- [Shop](/shop): Browse the full catalog of groceries, beverages and household items.
- [Cart](/cart): Review items before checkout.
- [Sign in](/auth): Customer phone login and account access.
- [Privacy policy](/privacy): How customer data is handled.
- [Terms of service](/terms): Terms governing use of the store.

## Optional

- [Order history](/orders): Past orders for signed-in customers.
